Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan qulqulluu sivilii, kutaalee kuusaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu fi meeshaaleen ittisaa kun jiraatanii utuu ta'ee lubbuun nama baay'ee ooluu akka danda'u himaniiru.

title: Toppled Bangladesh leader Sheikh Hasina to speak today: What we can expect
english: Former Bangladeshi leader Sheikh Hasina, who has been living in exile in India since her 2024 ouster, is scheduled to make a rare public statement via videolink. She faces a death sentence in her home country for her role in the violent suppression of student-led protests that resulted in many deaths. While the Bangladeshi government has blocked local media from broadcasting her remarks, she is expected to challenge the charges against her and discuss her potential political future.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 ከስልጣን የተባረሩት እና በህንድ በስደት የሚገኙት የቀድሞ የባንግላዲሽ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና በቪዲዮ ሊንክ በኩል በይፋዊ መግለጫ ሊሰጡ ነው። በባንግላዲሽ በነበረው የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ወቅት በወሰዱት የኃይል እርምጃ የሞት ፍርድ የተፈረደባቸው ሀሲና፣ በሀገራቸው የሚዲያ ስርጭት ቢታገድባቸውም በንግግራቸው ክሱን እንደሚቃወሙ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ክስተት ከሁለት አመት የፖለቲካ መገለል በኋላ የተፈጠረ ነው፣ ይህም የቀድሞዋን መሪ ወደ ፖለቲካ መድረክ የመመለስ ፍላጎት ሊያሳይ ይችላል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Bangladish kanaan dura turan Sheikh Hasina bara 2024 aangoorraa bu’anii Hindi keessatti baqattummaan kan jiraatan, yeroo dheeraa booda haasaa iddoo ummataa godhuuf qophaa’aniiru. Hasina mormii barattootaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhataniin lubbuun namaa akka darbu taasisuun himatamanii biyyattii isaaniitti adabbii du'aa itti murameera. Mootummaan Bangladish haasaa isaanii miidiyaaleen biyyattii keessaa akka hin dabarsine dhorkus, inni isaanii himannaa irratti dhiyaate kana mormuufi gara fuulduraatti gara siyaasaatti deebi'uu danda'an irratti akka xiyyeeffatan eegama.

title: Michigan, Missouri, Washington primary elections: Key takeaways
english: Primary elections in Michigan, Missouri, and Washington have highlighted an ongoing ideological divide within the Democratic Party regarding US policy on Israel. In Michigan, progressive Abdul El-Sayed and moderate Haley Stevens are in a tight race for the Senate nomination, which has become a significant test for the party's future direction. Because Michigan is a crucial swing state, the outcome of this contest is being closely watched as a bellwether for the upcoming November general election.
amharic: በሚቺጋን፣ ሚዙሪ እና ዋሽንግተን የተካሄዱት የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫዎች በእስራኤል ጉዳይ ላይ በዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያለውን የፖለቲካ ልዩነት አሳይተዋል። በሚቺጋን፣ ለሴኔት እጩነት በሂደት አራማጁ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ እና በመካከለኛው መስመር ተከታይዋ ሄይሊ ስቲቨንስ መካከል ያለው ፉክክር ለፓርቲው የወደፊት አቅጣጫ ወሳኝ ፈተና ሆኗል። ሚቺጋን ወሳኝ የሆነ የድምፅ አሰጣጥ ለውጥ የሚታይበት ግዛት በመሆኑ፣ የዚህ ምርጫ ውጤት ለህዳሩ አጠቃላይ ምርጫ እንደ ዋነኛ አመላካች እየታየ ነው።
oromo: Filannoon jalqabaa Michigan, Missouri fi Washington keessatti gaggeeffame, dhimma Israa'el irratti garee Dimokiraatota keessatti walitti bu'iinsa yaadaa jiru ifa baaseera. Michigan keessatti, Abdul El-Sayed kan jijjiirama barbaadu fi Haley Stevens kan giddu-galeessa taate gidduutti kan godhame dorgommiin paartichaaf qormaata guddaa ta'ee jira. Michigan naannoo filannoo wal madaalaa taate waan ta'eef, bu'aan dorgommii kanaa filannoo guutuu Sadaasaa dhufuuf mallattoo cimaa ta'ee ilaallamaa jira.

title: Trump hails progress but warned Iran of ‘hard hit’ if no deal reached
english: President Donald Trump stated that some progress has been achieved in diplomatic relations with Iran. However, he cautioned that the country will face severe military consequences if they fail to reach a formal agreement. Trump also revealed that the United States previously canceled a major planned military strike on Iran after the nation signaled an interest in discussions.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት የተወሰነ መሻሻል ታይቷል ብለዋል። ነገር ግን ስምምነት ላይ ካልተደረሰ ኢራን ከባድ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባት አስጠንቅቀዋል። ትራምፕ አክለውም ኢራን ለድርድር ፍላጎት ማሳየቷን ተከትሎ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ልትፈጽም የነበረውን መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት መሰረዟን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp hariiroo Iiraan wajjin qaban keessatti tarkaanfii gaariin mul’achuu isaa ibsaniiru. Ta’us, yoo waliigaltee irratti hin ga’amne ta’e, Iiraan miidhaa waraanaa cimaa akka ishee mudatu akeekkachiisaniiru. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Iiraan mariif fedhii agarsiisuu isheetiin walqabatee, Ameerikaan miidhaa waraanaa guddaa ishee irratti raawwachuuf karoorfate ture dhaabuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Cape Verde’s World Cup hero, social media sensation Vozinha joins Colo-Colo
english: Cape Verdean goalkeeper Vozinha has signed with the historic Chilean club Colo-Colo following his impressive performance at the World Cup. The 40-year-old athlete expressed his excitement to join such a prestigious team after years of playing in smaller leagues. His successful run in the tournament, which included holding major nations to draws, helped boost his international profile and secure this new opportunity.
amharic: የኬፕ ቨርዴው ግብ ጠባቂ ቮዚንሃ በዓለም ዋንጫው ላይ ባሳየው አስደናቂ ብቃት ምክንያት ወደ ቺሊው ታዋቂ ክለብ ኮሎ-ኮሎ ተዘዋውሯል። የ40 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ከዚህ ቀደም በትንንሽ ሊጎች ሲጫወት ከቆየ በኋላ አሁን ትልቅ ክለብ በመቀላቀሉ የተሰማውን ደስታ ገልጿል። በዓለም ዋንጫው ለሀገሩ ያሳየው ጥሩ እንቅስቃሴ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ትኩረትን እንዲያገኝ እና ይህን አዲስ ዕድል እንዲያገኝ አስችሎታል።
oromo: Golkeepperiin biyya Keeyp Veerdee Vozinha, tapha isa waa’ee Waancaa Addunyaa irratti agarsiise booda gara kilabii beekamaa biyya Chiilii kan ta'e Colo-Colo tti makameera. Umriin isaa waggaa 40 kan ta'e atileetichi, waggoota dheeraaf liigii xiqqaa keessatti taphataa erga turee booda kilabii guddaa akkanaa waliin walitti makamuun isaa isa gammachiiseera. Taphoota Waancaa Addunyaa irratti biyyoota gurguddoo irratti agarsiise fi sadarkaa isaa guddisuun, carraa kana akka argatu isa gargaareera.

title: Pakistan and Uganda athletes ‘missing’ after Commonwealth Games
english: Police in Scotland are investigating the disappearance of several athletes from Pakistan and Uganda who failed to return home following the conclusion of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Reports indicate that some of these athletes may be intending to seek asylum. This incident follows a historical pattern of participants vanishing during international sporting events held in nations like Britain and Australia.

oromo: Poolisiin Iskotland garee ispoortii Paakistaanii fi Yugaandaa irraa taphattoonni tokko tokko tapha Komoniweelzi Gilaasgowitti erga xumuramee booda gara biyyatti deebi'uu diduun isaanii qorachaa jira. Iyyattoonni kun sagantaa tapha kana booda bakka hin beekamnetti kan badaniif, dawoo gaafachuuf karoorfatanii ta'uu mala jedhamee shakkama. Akkuma kanaan dura biyyoota akka Biriiteenii fi Awustiraaliyaatti taphoota idil-addunyaa irratti mul'achaa ture, yeroo ammas waa'een atileetota badanii kun xiyyeeffannaa argatee jira.

title: Nigeria cannot build safe schools in unsafe communities
english: Despite the implementation of the Safe Schools Initiative, Nigerian students continue to face abduction risks because the program focuses primarily on school infrastructure rather than surrounding regional security. Although the government has expanded safety measures since the Chibok tragedy, recent kidnappings demonstrate that school protection remains ineffective when the broader environment is dangerous. Experts suggest that true safety for students will only be achieved by addressing the persistent lack of security in the communities beyond school grounds.
amharic: የደህንነት ትምህርት ቤቶች ተነሳሽነት ቢኖርም፣ የኒጄሪያ ተማሪዎች በዋናነት በትምህርት ቤት መሰረተ ልማት ላይ እንጂ በአካባቢው ሰፊ የፀጥታ ሁኔታ ላይ ትኩረት ባለማድረጉ ለጠለፋ ተጋላጭ ናቸው። ከቺቦክ አደጋ ወዲህ መንግስት የደህንነት እርምጃዎችን ቢያሰፋም፣ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጠለፋዎች ትምህርት ቤቶች ብቻቸውን ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ አለመሆኑን ያሳያሉ። ለተማሪዎች ዘላቂ ሰላም የሚገኘው በትምህርት ቤቶች ውጪ ባሉ ማህበረሰቦች ውስጥ ያለውን የፀጥታ ችግር በመፍታት ብቻ እንደሆነ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Sagantaan manneen barnootaa eegumsa qabaatan kunneen utuu jiranii, barattoonni Naayijeeriyaa haala nageenyaa naannawaa isaanirratti xiyyeeffannoon waan hin kennamneef ammallee butamuuf saaxilamu. Mootummaan erga balaa Chibok booda tarkaanfii nageenyaa babal'iseellee, butiinii dhihoo kun manneen barnootaa kophaatti eeguun ga'aa akka hin taane agarsiisa. Ogeeyyoonni akka jedhanitti, nageenyi dhugaan kan mirkanaa'u naannoo manneen barnootaa alatti argamu keessatti nageenya buusuun qofaadha.

title: Alcaraz withdraws from Cincinnati event as doubts grow over US Open defence
english: Tennis star Carlos Alcaraz has withdrawn from the Cincinnati Open due to a persistent wrist injury. This latest setback raises significant concerns regarding his ability to compete in the upcoming US Open. While the seven-time Grand Slam champion has been training, he has not yet confirmed his status for any remaining tournaments before the major event.

oromo: Taphataan tenisi beekamaan Kaarloos Alkaaraaz miidhaa harka isaarra ga'een walqabatee dorgommii 'Cincinnati Open' irraa akka of duuba deebise beekameera. Mudannoon kun dorgommii 'US Open' dhufuuf jedhurratti hirmaachuun isaa shakkiin akka uumamu godheera. Kaarloos taphoota gurguddoo torba injifate kun leenjii cimaa gochaa kan jiru ta'us, dorgommiiwwan gurguddoon kun jalqabuu dura taphoota biroo irratti hirmaachuuf murteessuu isaa hanga ammaatti ifa hin godhe.

title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic primary for Senate, NBC projects
english: Progressive candidate Abdul El-Sayed has secured the Democratic nomination for the US Senate in Michigan after defeating Congresswoman Haley Stevens. Despite significant financial opposition from pro-Israel groups, El-Sayed advanced to the general election where he will face Republican Mike Rogers. If successful in November, El-Sayed would become the first Muslim senator in American history.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ በሚቺጋን የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ የሴኔት ምርጫ አሸናፊ በመሆን ለህዳር ወር አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ማለፋቸው ተገለጸ። ተወዳዳሪው በእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ተጽዕኖ ቢደረግባቸውም ድሉን መቀዳጀት ችለዋል። በህዳር ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ የሚያሸንፉ ከሆነ፣ በአሜሪካ ታሪክ የመጀመሪያው ሙስሊም ሴናተር ይሆናሉ።
oromo: Abdul El-Sayed filannoo duraa kan paartii Dimokiraatawaa kan Michigan keessatti sagalee baay'ee argachuun injifatan. Morkataa isaanii kan ta'an Haley Stevens garee Israa'el deggeran irraa deggarsa maallaqaa cimaa argatanis, El-Sayed injifannoo argachuu danda'aniiru. Yoo baatii Sadaasaa dhufu injifatan, seenaa Ameerikaa keessatti senaatarri Muslima ta'an jalqabaa ta'u.

title: The yearly mild weather spell that brings Yemen’s coast back to life
english: The annual Al-Baldah climate phenomenon brings a temporary period of refreshing, cool weather to the coastal city of Mukalla in Yemen. This event attracts thousands of visitors to the beaches, providing a much-needed escape from the region's usual intense summer heat. For local residents, the influx of tourists creates a rare economic opportunity to earn income through small businesses like food stalls, offering a brief respite from the hardships of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በየዓመቱ የሚከሰተው የአል-ባልዳህ የተፈጥሮ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ በየመን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ የምትገኘው ሙካላ ከተማ ለጥቂት ሳምንታት ቀዝቃዛና አስደሳች የአየር ንብረት እንዲኖራት ያደርጋል። ይህ ወቅት በርካታ ጎብኚዎችን ወደ አካባቢው በመሳብ ከተማዋን ህያው የሚያደርግ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎችም በምግብ መሸጫ እና በተለያዩ ስራዎች ተጨማሪ ገቢ የሚያገኙበት አጋጣሚን ይፈጥራል። ይህ ክስተት በጦርነትና በችግር ለሚሰቃዩት የየመን ህዝቦች ለአጭር ጊዜም ቢሆን ከኑሮ ውጥረት የሚላቀቁበት ተስፋ ሰጪ ጊዜ ሆኖ አገልግሏል።
oromo: Hawaanxoon 'Al-Baldah' jedhamu kan waggaa waggaan uumamu, magaalaa Mukalla kan Yamanitti argamtu irratti yeroo gabaabaaf qilleensa gaarii fi qabbanaa'aa fida. Taateen kun namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman gara qarqara galaanichaatti hawwatee, ho'a guyyaa daran cimaa ta'e irraa boqonnaa akka argatan taasisa. Jiraattonni magaalaa kunis, namoota hedduu kana fayyadamudhaan nyaata fi dhugaatii gurgurachaa galii argachuuf carraa guddaa argatu; kunis waraana biyyattii keessa jiruun miidhamaniif gargaarsa xiqqoo ta'us gammachuu fi fayyadama dinagdee kenna.

title: Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv kills two and injures others, officials say
english: A major Russian ballistic missile and drone attack on Kyiv and its surrounding areas has resulted in two deaths and at least 24 injuries. The overnight assault targeted civilian neighborhoods, causing significant damage and leaving authorities concerned that residents may remain trapped beneath collapsed structures. In response to the intensifying conflict, Ukrainian officials are calling for additional defensive missile systems to better protect their cities from these aerial strikes.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢዋ ባደረሰችው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል እና የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ቢያንስ 24 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። በሌሊት በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች በመመታታቸው የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር የተጠመዱ ሰዎች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ ስጋት አላቸው። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት በከተማዎቻቸው ላይ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የከፍተኛ ጥቃት ለመመከት ተጨማሪ የመከላከያ መሳሪያዎችን ለማግኘት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Raashiyaan magaalaa Kiyevii fi naannawa ishee irratti miisaayilaa fi dooniiwwan hidhataniin haleellaa geggeessiten lubbuun namoota lamaa yoo darbu, namoonni 24 ol ammoo madaa’aniiru. Haleellaa halkan keessa raawwatame kanaan manneen jireenyaa fi bu’uuraaleenalee misoomaa miidhamaniiru; abbootii aangoo mootummaa birattis namoonni diigamuu manaa jala hafan ta’uu danda’uun sodaan uumameera. Rakkoo kana dhaabsisuuf, mootummaan Yukreenii magaaloowwan ishee haleellaa kanarraa ittisuuf meeshaalee waraanaa dabalataa akka argattu gargaarsa gaafachaa jirti.

title: Bolivia sends troops to stop Brazilian gang violence along border
english: The Bolivian government has deployed over 200 soldiers and police officers to the border region shared with Brazil. This move aims to curb a surge in violence resulting from territorial conflicts between rival Brazilian criminal organizations fighting over drug smuggling routes. At least nine people have reportedly lost their lives due to these ongoing clashes.
amharic: የቦሊቪያ መንግስት ከብራዚል ጋር በሚዋሰነው ድንበር ላይ የተከሰተውን የጥቃት ማዕበል ለመቆጣጠር ከ200 በላይ ወታደሮችን እና ፖሊሶችን አሰማርቷል። እርምጃው የተወሰደው በብራዚል የወንጀል ቡድኖች መካከል የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር መንገዶችን ለመቆጣጠር በሚደረግ ግጭት ምክንያት ነው። በዚህ ግጭት እስካሁን ቢያንስ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች መሞታቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Boliviyaa daangaa biyyattiin Birazil waliin qabdu irratti jeequmsa uumame to’achuuf waraanaafi poolisoota 200 ol ergeera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame gareewwan yakkaa Birazil gidduutti karaa gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu to’achuuf wal loluun walitti bu’iinsa uumameef dha. Walitti bu’iinsa kana kanaan namoonni sagal ol ta’an du’aniiru.

title: North Korea’s Kim Yo Jong issues military threat over Japan missile test
english: Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korea's leader, has issued a sharp warning against Japan following its recent test of a U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missile. She accused Tokyo of shifting toward an aggressive military stance and blamed the United States for supporting this buildup. Pyongyang indicated it would respond with new military actions, suggesting that these joint defense activities have placed regional security at greater risk.
amharic: የሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ እህት ኪም ዮ ጆንግ፣ ጃፓን አሜሪካ ሰራሽ የሆነውን ቶማሃውክ የተሰኘ ክሩዝ ሚሳይል መሞከሯን ተከትሎ ጠንካራ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። ጃፓን የመከላከል አቅሟን ወደ ጥቃት የመፈጸም አቅም እያሳደገች እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ለአሜሪካ ድጋፍ ተጠያቂ አድርገዋል። ሰሜን ኮሪያ ለዚህ ድርጊት ተገቢውን ወታደራዊ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ በመግለጽ፣ ይህ የጃፓን እና የአሜሪካ ጥምረት ለቀጠናው ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: obboleettiin geggeessaa biyya Koriyaa Kaabaa Kim Yo Jong, biyyi Jaappaan mishaayila 'Tomahawk' jedhamu kan Ameerikaa irraa bittee qorannoo taasisuun ishee booda, biyyattii irratti akeekkachiisa cimaa dabarsiteetti. Jaappaan gara duulaatti ce’aa akka jirtu himattee, guddina waraanaa kanaaf Ameerikaan itti gaafatamtuu akka taate himteetti. Koriyaan Kaabaa tarkaanfiiwwan Jaappaan fudhachaa jirtu kanaaf deebii waraanaa akka kennitu ibsuun, walta’iinsi kun nageenya naannichaa balaa irra buuseera jetteetti.

title: Protesters demand answers from ICE after second man dies at Delaney Hall
english: Demonstrators are calling for transparency from immigration authorities following the death of a 41-year-old Salvadoran man at the Delaney Hall detention center in New Jersey. The man, Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, passed away after experiencing a medical crisis while in custody. This incident marks the second death at the facility, prompting increased public concern and demands for accountability.
amharic: በኒው ጀርሲ በሚገኘው የዴላኒ ሆል እስር ቤት የ41 ዓመት ኤል ሳልቫዶራዊ ሰው ህይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ ተቃዋሚዎች ከኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ማብራሪያ እየጠየቁ ነው። ኤድዊን ሎፔዝ-ኮርኔጆ በተያዘበት ወቅት በደረሰበት የጤና እክል ምክንያት ህይወቱ አልፏል። ይህ በግቢው ውስጥ የተመዘገበ ሁለተኛው የሞት ክስተት በመሆኑ፣ ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞና ተጠያቂነትን የመጠየቅ እንቅስቃሴ ጨምሯል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa waggaa 41 ta'e kan biyya El-Saalvaador, bakka qabsoo isaanii kan Delaney Hall, New Jersey keessatti erga du'ee booda, namoonni mormiin dhageessisan aangessitoota imigireeshinii irraa ibsa barbaadu. Edwin Lopez-Cornejo iddoo qabsoo sanaa keessatti rakkoo fayyaa mudateen du'uu isaa gabaafameera. Kun du'a lammaffaa bakka kana keessatti raawwatame waan ta'eef, uummatni mormii isaa guddisuun gaafatamummaan akka jiraatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Israel approves $37m to seize more than 70 occupied West Bank sites
english: The Israeli government has allocated $37 million to gain control over more than 70 historical and archaeological sites within the occupied West Bank. Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich frames this move as a way to preserve Jewish heritage, though these locations are located on Palestinian land. These actions are part of a broader, ongoing expansion of settlements that remain illegal under international law.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚገኙ ከ70 በላይ ታሪካዊ እና አርኪኦሎጂያዊ ቦታዎችን ለመቆጣጠር 37 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በጀት መድቧል። የገንዘብ ሚኒስትሩ በዛሌል ስሞትሪች ይህ እርምጃ የአይሁድ ቅርሶችን ለመጠበቅ ያለመ መሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ ቦታዎቹ ግን በፓለስቲናውያን መሬት ላይ የሚገኙ ናቸው። ይህ ተግባር በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ ህገ-ወጥ ተደርገው በሚቆጠሩት ሰፈራዎች ማስፋፊያ ስራ አካል ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-gama (West Bank) keessatti bakkeewwan seena-qabeessaafi arki'ooloojii 70 ol ta'an to'achuuf qarshii miiliyoona 37 ramadeera. Ministirri Maallaqaa Bezalel Smotrich tarkaanfiin kun dhaala warra Yihuudii eeguuf kan yaadame ta'uu ibsanus, bakkeewwan kun biyya Palastiinii keessatti kan argamanidha. Gochi kun babal'ina buufataalee seeraan alaa ta'anii kanneen seera idil-addunyaatiin hin beekamne keessatti kan galuudha.

title: US stock market hits record high amid hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening
english: The US stock market reached unprecedented record highs driven by strong corporate earnings and positive expectations regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. As negotiations led by Iran and Oman progress, international oil prices have declined due to the anticipated restoration of this vital shipping route. This market optimism has also triggered significant growth in key Asian stock exchanges.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የአክሲዮን ገበያ በኩባንያዎች ጠንካራ የገቢ አፈጻጸም እና የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ዳግም ይከፈታል በሚል ተስፋ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ደረጃ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል። ኢራን እና ኦማን በባህረ ሰላጤው የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ላይ እያደረጉት ያለው ድርድር ውጤታማ ይሆናል በሚል እምነት የነዳጅ ዋጋ ቀንሷል። ይህ የተስፋ መንፈስ በእስያ ዋና ዋና የአክሲዮን ገበያዎች ላይም አዎንታዊ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaan aksiyoonii US bu'aa qabeessa ta'uu dhaabbilee fi abdii daandii galaana Hormuz deebi'ee banamuu irratti hundaa'uun hanga kanaan dura hin mul'anneen guddina galmeesseera. Hariiroon biyyoota Iraan fi Omaan gidduutti taasifamaa jiru bu'aa qabaata jedhamee waan amanameef, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa gadi bu'eera. Abdii gabaa kanaanis gabaawwan aksiyoonii gurguddoon biyyoota Eeshiyaa guddina olaanaa agarsiisaniiru.

title: US depleted 'virtually all' long-range precision missiles during Iran war: Report
english: A recent report indicates that the United States has nearly exhausted its supply of advanced long-range precision missiles following its military engagement with Iran. These weapons are vital for targeting enemies from a distance, and their depletion has forced the military to relocate remaining stocks from other global regions. This shortage raises concerns regarding the US military's capacity to sustain high-level strikes without these key precision capabilities.

Meeshaaleen kunneen diina fageenya irraa rukutuuf baayyee barbaachisoo waan ta'aniif, waraanni Amerikaa amansiisaa ta'e tokko argachuuf meeshaalee isaa bakka biraa irraa guuruuf dirqamee jira. Hanqinni kun ammoo Amerikaan gara fuulduraatti waraana irratti hirmaachuu irratti rakkoo guddaa akka qabaattu shakkisiisaa jira.

title: Trump says talks with Tehran 'very good', threatens to strike if Hormuz Strait remains closed
english: President Trump recently revealed that the United States is engaged in positive negotiations with Iran regarding a potential agreement. However, he also issued a stern warning that Iran must reopen the Strait of Hormuz quickly. If the area remains blocked, the president stated that the U.S. will respond with significant military force.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ አዎንታዊ ድርድር እያደረገች መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም ኢራን የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን በአስቸኳይ ካልከፈተች ጠንካራ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስጠንቅቀዋል። አካባቢው እንደተዘጋ ከቀጠለ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት እንደምትሰነዝር አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaan Iran waliin waligaltee irra gahuuf marii gaarii gochaa akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Ta'us, Iran daandii galaana Hormuz ariitiin banuu qabdi jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru. Daandichi yoo banamuu baate, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhachuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru.

title: Explosions reportedly heard in Yemeni capital of Sanaa
english: There have been reports of explosions occurring in Sanaa, the capital city of Yemen. At this time, officials have not confirmed the details of the event. Furthermore, video evidence circulating regarding the incident is currently unverified.
amharic: በየመን ዋና ከተማ በሆነችው ሰንዓ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ ሪፖርቶች እየወጡ ነው። እስካሁን ድረስ የዚህ ክስተት ዝርዝር መረጃ በአለማቀፍ አካላት አልተረጋገጠም። እንዲሁም ስለ ጉዳዩ እየተሰራጩ የሚገኙ የምስል ማስረጃዎች ትክክለኛነት እስካሁን አልተረጋገጠም።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Yemen, Sanaa keessatti dhoohaan dhaga’amuu isaa gabaasni ni mul’isu. Haa ta’u malee, hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon kun qaama aangoo qabuun kan mirkanaa’e miti. Akkasumas, viidiyoon haala kanaan walqabatee gadi dhiifame dhugummaan isaa hin mirkanaa’e.

title: Reports of blasts in Dubai
english: Several explosions recently occurred within the Jebel Ali industrial zone located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Videos circulating on social media platforms display significant clouds of smoke billowing from the site. Authorities have not yet provided specific details regarding the cause or any potential casualties.
amharic: በተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ዱባይ በሚገኘው የጄበል አሊ የኢንዱስትሪ ቀጠና ውስጥ በርካታ ፍንዳታዎች ተከስተዋል። በማህበራዊ ሚዲያዎች ላይ በተለቀቁ ምስሎች መሠረት ከፍተኛ የሆነ የጭስ ክምችት ወደ ሰማይ ሲወጣ ታይቷል። ባለስልጣናት እስካሁን ስለ ፍንዳታው መንስኤ ወይም ስለደረሰው ጉዳት ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Emirates Gamtootaa Arabaa, magaalaa Dubaayitti, naannoo warshaa Jebel Alitti osoon gurguddoon dhukaanii akka uumame gabaafame. Viidiyoowwan miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti qoodaman irraa akka hubatamutti, aaraan guddaan bakka sana irraa ol bahaa jira. Abbootiin taayitaa hanga ammaa sababa dhukichaafi miidhaa ga'e irratti ibsa gahaa hin kennine.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is rooted in a cultural tendency to favor strict hierarchy and unquestioning obedience over open dialogue. This pattern begins in households and schools, where children learn that challenging authority is often discouraged or penalized. These ingrained habits carry over into workplaces and government institutions, where fear of retaliation suppresses dissent and prevents necessary systemic change.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዲሞክራሲ ሂደት ተግዳሮት በዋናነት የተመሠረተው ሥልጣንን ያለ ጥያቄ የመቀበልና የባህላዊ አስተዳደር ሥርዓትን የመከተል ዝንባሌ ላይ ነው። ይህ አሠራር ከቤተሰብና ከትምህርት ቤት የሚጀምር ሲሆን፣ ልጆች ሥልጣንን መቃወም እንደ ጥፋት እንዲቆጥሩ ይገደዳሉ። እነዚህ ሥር የሰደዱ ልማዶች ወደ ቢሮዎችና የመንግሥት ተቋማት በመሸጋገር፣ ሰዎች ለሥራቸው ደኅንነት ሲሉ ሃሳባቸውን እንዳይገልጹ በማድረግ ለውጥን ያደናቅፋሉ።

title: Iran war live: Tehran-Oman talks on Hormuz ‘positive’; ship hit in Red Sea
english: Diplomatic discussions between Iran and Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz are reportedly showing positive progress. Both Iranian officials and US government representatives have signaled that an agreement to resolve the ongoing crisis could be finalized in the coming days. Meanwhile, reports indicate that a ship has been struck in the Red Sea as regional tensions persist.
amharic: በኢራን እና በኦማን መካከል ስለ ሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ እየተደረጉ ያሉ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይቶች አዎንታዊ ውጤት እያሳዩ መሆኑ ተገልጿል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እና የአሜሪካ መንግስት ተወካዮች ችግሩን ለመፍታት የሚያስችል ስምምነት በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ሊደረስ እንደሚችል አመላክተዋል። በሌላ በኩል የቀይ ባህር ውጥረቶች እንደቀጠሉ ሲሆን አንድ መርከብ ጥቃት እንደደረሰበት ተነግሯል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan diippilomaasii gidduu Iraanii fi Omaan gidduutti, kan dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz irratti xiyyeeffate, bu'aa gaarii argamsiisaa jiraachuun ibsameera. Gama biraatiin, naannoo Galaana Diimaatti walitti bu'iinsi itti fufuun isaa fi dooniin tokko rukutamuu ishee gabaasni ni mul'isu.

title: US revokes visa of Brazilian ambassador amid deepening diplomatic spat
english: The Trump administration has revoked the visa of Brazil's ambassador to the United States in response to Brazil's delay in approving the American nominee for ambassador to Brasilia. Although the diplomat’s visa is currently cancelled, officials clarified that she is not being expelled from the country. The U.S. stated that her travel documents will be reinstated as soon as Brazil agrees to accept the American candidate, Danny Perez.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በብራዚል በኩል የአሜሪካውን አምባሳደር የመሾም ሂደት በመዘግየቱ ምክንያት የብራዚሏን አምባሳደር ቪዛ ሰርዘዋል። የቪዛው መሰረዝ አምባሳደሯ ከአሜሪካ እንዲባረሩ አያደርግም ሲሉ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል። ብራዚል የአሜሪካውን እጩ ዳኒ ፔሬዝን እንደተቀበለች የቪዛ እገዳው እንደሚነሳም ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Prezidaant Doonaald Traamp, Braaziliin bakka buutuu ambaasaaddara Ameerikaa gara biyya ishee ergamuudhaaf jiru mirkaneessuu waan turteef, ambaasaaddara Braazil kan Ameerikaa jiran irratti tarkaanfii viizaa fudhateera. Ta'us, kun ambaasaaddarittiin biyyattiirraa akka ari'aman kan godhu miti jedhameera. Ameerikaan, Braazil naggaddee ambaasaaddara Ameerikaa kan ta'an Daanii Pereez fudhachuu yoo mirkaneessite, viizaan ambaasaaddarittii akka deebi'uuf ibsiteetti.

title: Sri Lanka shuts schools as floods and mudslides kill 7
english: Heavy rainfall in Sri Lanka's central highlands has triggered deadly mudslides and floods, resulting in seven fatalities and significant infrastructure damage. Authorities have closed schools in the affected districts and deployed military personnel to evacuate thousands of residents trapped by the rising waters. This disaster comes as the region continues to struggle with the aftermath of previous severe weather events.
amharic: በስሪላንካ መካከለኛ ተራራማ አካባቢዎች በጣለ ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተከሰተ ጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። መንግስት በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች ትምህርት ቤቶችን የዘጋ ሲሆን፣ በጎርፍ የተጠመዱ ሺዎችን ለመታደግ የፀጥታ ኃይሎችን አሰማርቷል። ይህ አደጋ ክልሉ ካለፉት የተፈጥሮ አደጋዎች ለማገገም እየጣረ ባለበት ወቅት የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Sri Lankaatti rooba cimaan roobeen hordofee lolaa fi lafti siggiguun lubbuun namoota torbaa darbeera. Bulchiinsi biyyattii manneen barnootaa bakka balaan gahetti akka cufaman taasiseera; akkasumas namoota lolaan qabaman gargaaruuf loltoota bobbaaseera. Balaan kun kan mudate, naannichi balaa rooba kanaan duraatiin miidhamee deebi'ee of ijaaruuf carraaqqii gochaa jirutti.

title: One killed, five injured in Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
english: A Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv has resulted in one death and five injuries, while causing significant property damage and fires in the capital. Local officials report that air defense systems were deployed to counter the assault, but several buildings were still struck. President Zelenskyy highlighted this tragedy as further evidence of the urgent need for more international support to strengthen Ukraine's missile defense capabilities.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪዬቭ ላይ በፈጸመችው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቱ በከተማዋ የንግድ መጋዘኖች ላይ እሳት ከመቀስቀሱም በላይ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን አውድሟል። የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ፣ ይህ ጥቃት ሀገራቸው የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች እንደሚያስፈልጋት የሚያሳይ መሆኑን ገልጸው ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Raashiyaan magaalaa Kiyiv irratti xiyyaara kombii (ballistic missile) fayyadamtee haleellaa geessisteen lubbuun nama tokkoo darbee namoonni shan ammoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun gamoo fi manneen jireenyaa irratti miidhaa geessisuun cinatti, magaalaattis ibidda kaaseera. Preezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski haleellaan kun Yukreen of ittisuuf meeshaalee waraanaa ammayyaa fi deeggarsa idil-addunyaa akka barbaaddu kan mirkaneessu ta’uu dubbataniiru.

title: Hezbollah chief criticises Lebanon's direct talks with Israel
english: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem has publicly condemned Lebanese President Joseph Aoun for engaging in direct peace negotiations with Israel. Qassem accused the president of acting in a biased and divisive manner regarding these talks. Meanwhile, the Hezbollah chief stated he is open to holding public discussions with the Syrian government.
amharic: የሂዝቦላህ መሪ ናኢም ቀሲም የሊባኖሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ጆሴፍ አውን ከእስራኤል ጋር ቀጥተኛ ድርድር በማድረጋቸው ተችተዋል። ቀሲም ፕሬዝዳንቱ አድሎአዊ እና አገር ከፋፋይ አቋም አሳይተዋል ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል። በተመሳሳይ የሂዝቦላህ መሪ ከሶሪያ አመራሮች ጋር በይፋ ለመወያየት ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan garee Hizboollah Na'iim Qassiim, pirezidaantii Libanoos Jooseef Aawun Israa'el waliin marii kallattiin taasiisuusaanii mormaniiru. Qassiim pirezidaantichi tarkaanfii lolaa fi wal-qoqqoodinsa uumu fudhateera jechuun isaan komataniiru. Gama biraatiin, hogganaan Hizboollah kun hoogganoota Sooriyaa waliin marii ifa ta'e gochuuf fedhii qabaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Evening update
english: Tensions in the Middle East remain high as Israel continues military actions in Lebanon and the West Bank while rejecting specific Gaza peace plans. Meanwhile, an Indian ship was rescued near Yemen after a projectile strike, and ongoing regional diplomatic talks are addressing maritime safety concerns. Additionally, the U.S. is taking measures to manage energy costs as the conflict impacts global shipping routes.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት ቀጥሏል፤ እስራኤል በሊባኖስ እና በዌስት ባንክ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰደች ሲሆን የጋዛን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። በሌላ በኩል በየመን አቅራቢያ የህንድ መርከብ ጥቃት ደርሶባት የነበረ ቢሆንም ሁሉም ሰራተኞች በደህና መትረፋቸው ተገልጿል። በተጨማሪም አሜሪካ በግጭቱ ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ለመቆጣጠር እርምጃዎችን እየወሰደች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Giddugaleessa Bahaatti waraanni fi tasgabbii dhabuun itti fufee jira; Israa’el gama Libaanoosii fi Baanki Dhihaa waraana gaggeessaa jirti akkasumas karoora nagaa Gaazaarratti dhiyaate fudhachuu dideetti. Gama biraan, dooniin Indiyaa tokko qarqara Yamanitti erga haleelamtee booda hojjettoonni hundi lubbuun oolaniiru. Akkasumas, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa waraanni gatii boba’aarratti geessise hir’isuuf tarkaanfii fudhachaa jirti.

title: Board of Peace official says Gaza roadmap faces long, difficult process
english: A peace official stated that implementing the Gaza roadmap will be a lengthy and challenging endeavor. The plan aims to improve the future for Palestinians by removing Hamas from power while ensuring security for Israelis. Officials acknowledged that the transition, which requires Hamas to disarm and yield control to a technical government, faces significant hurdles.
amharic: የሰላም ቦርድ ባለስልጣን የጋዛን የሰላም ፍኖተ-ካርታ ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ረጅም እና አስቸጋሪ ሂደት እንደሚጠይቅ ገልጸዋል። ይህ እቅድ ሀማስ ከስልጣን እንዲወርድ በማድረግ ለፍልስጤማውያን የተሻለ የወደፊት ተስፋን እና ለእስራኤላውያን ደህንነትን ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። ሀማስ ስልጣኑን ለቴክኖክራት መንግስት እንዲያስረክብ እና መሳሪያውን እንዲፈታ መጠበቅ ከባድ መሆኑም ተመልክቷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa akka jedhanitti, karoorri nageenyaa Gaazaaf bahe adeemsa dheeraa fi rakkisaa ta'ee dha. Karoorichi Hamas aangoorraa kaasuun saba Falasxiinif gara fuulduraa gaarii uumuu fi nageenya Israa'elotaa eeguu kan kaayyeeffate dha. Hamas aangoo gadhiisee mootummaa teeknikaatiif akka dabarsuufi meeshaa waraanaa akka hiiku gaafachuun immoo gufuu guddaa akka qabu ibsameera.

title: Armed man with armour-piercing bullets arrested near Trump's California golf course
english: Authorities in California arrested a 38-year-old man named Jeanine John Taele near a golf course owned by Donald Trump. The suspect was found with a handgun and armor-piercing bullets while allegedly observing security preparations for a presidential visit. Police took him into custody on Sunday before the planned Republican fundraising event.
amharic: የካሊፎርኒያ ባለሥልጣናት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሚያስተዳድሩት የጎልፍ ሜዳ አቅራቢያ የ38 ዓመቱን ዣኒን ጆን ታኤል የተባለ ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪው የፕሬዚዳንቱን ጉብኝት የጸጥታ ዝግጅቶች ሲከታተል እንደነበር የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ በተሽከርካሪው ውስጥ ሽጉጥ እና ትጥቅ ሰንጣቂ ጥይቶች ተገኝተውበታል። ግለሰቡ ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ የገቢ ማሰባሰቢያ ፕሮግራም ሊካሄድ ጥቂት ቀናት ሲቀሩት ነው የተያዘው።
oromo: Humni poolisii Kaaliifoorniyaa nama umrii 38 kan ta'e Jeanine John Taele jedhamu dirree goolfii kan Donald Trump ta'e biratti qabaniiru. Shakkamichi meeshaa waraanaa fi dhukaata gosa adda ta'e qabatee eegumsa isaa hordofaa akka ture himameera. Namni kun kan qabame guyyaa Dilbataa yoo ta'u, turee sagantaa walitti qaba maallaqa paartii Ripaabilikaanii dura ture.

title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX reports losses but less than expected
english: SpaceX recently announced a quarterly loss of over $500 million, which was significantly lower than what financial experts had predicted. Despite the loss, the company experienced a massive 90 percent surge in revenue, reaching $7.8 billion, driven largely by its Starlink satellite internet services and major government contracts. Elon Musk's company is currently investing heavily in expanding its satellite infrastructure and AI technology, including the upcoming launch of new AI-capable satellites.
amharic: ስፔስ ኤክስ በቅርቡ ባወጣው የሩብ ዓመት ሪፖርት ከ500 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ኪሳራ እንዳጋጠመው አስታውቋል፤ ሆኖም ይህ መጠን የገበያ ተንታኞች ከጠበቁት በታች ነው። ኪሳራው ቢኖርም የኩባንያው ገቢ ከባለፈው ዓመት ጋር ሲነጻጸር በ90 በመቶ በማደግ 7.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ደርሷል፤ ይህም በዋናነት በስታርሊንክ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት እና በመንግስት ውሎች የተገኘ ነው። ኤሎን ማስክ የኩባንያውን የሳተላይት መሠረተ ልማት እና አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ቴክኖሎጂን ለማስፋፋት ከፍተኛ ኢንቨስትመንት እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: SpaceX gabaasa baatiiwwan sadan darban keessatti kan baaseen, kisaaraan isaa gara biliyoona walakkaa ol ta'us, kun garuu tilmaama ogeeyyiin gabaa kennanii gadi ta'uu beeksiseera. Kisaaraa kana keessa iyyuu, galii kampaanichaa dhibbeentaa 90 ol dabaluun gara biliyoona 7.8 ga'eera; kunis tajaajila internetii Starlink fi waliigaltee mootummaa irraa kan argame dha. Kampaanichi kan Elon Musk, bu'uuraalee misoomaa hawaa fi teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' babal'isuuf qarshii guddaa baasaa jira.

title: How the far right weaponised the Ceuta crisis
english: A tragic incident involving the deaths of over 70 migrants attempting to reach Ceuta quickly transformed into a major political controversy. Far-right groups exploited the humanitarian disaster to advance their own agendas, sparking intense debate in Spain. Analysts warn that the political fallout from this crisis may have significant and long-lasting consequences far beyond Spanish borders.
amharic: ወደ ሴኡታ ለመድረስ ሲሞክሩ ከ72 በላይ ስደተኞች ህይወታቸው ያለፈበት አሳዛኝ ክስተት በፍጥነት ወደ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ ተቀይሯል። የቀኝ አክራሪ ቡድኖች ይህንን ሰብአዊ ቀውስ የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ አጀንዳ ለማራመድ ተጠቅመውበታል፣ ይህም በስፔን ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ክርክር አስነስቷል። ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት ከዚህ ቀውስ የሚመነጨው የፖለቲካ መዘዝ ከስፔን ድንበር አልፎ በሌሎች አካባቢዎችም የረጅም ጊዜ ተጽእኖ ሊኖረው ይችላል።
oromo: Godaanonni 72 ol ta’an gara Se'utaatti ce'uuf yaalii godhan irratti lubbuun isaanii darbuun isaa, yeruma sana gara jeequumsa siyaasaatti jijjiirameera. Gareewwan mirga-fayyotaa (far-right) balaa namoomaa kana gara faayidaa siyaasaa mataa isaanii oolchuun, biyya Ispeen keessatti falmii cimaa kaaseera. Ogeeyyonni akka ibsanitti, rakkoon siyaasaa mudate kun daangaa Ispeen darbee dhiibbaa gara fuulduraa gurguddaa qabaachuu danda'a.

title: Funeral for family killed in US strike on Iran’s Qeshm Island
english: A funeral has taken place for a couple and their young child who were killed during a recent United States military strike on Iran's Qeshm Island. Following the tragedy, senior Iranian official Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf condemned the action and warned that the U.S. would face consequences for the attack. The event has further strained tensions in the region.
amharic: በኢራን ቃሽም ደሴት በአሜሪካ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ቤተሰቦች የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓት ተፈጽሟል። በጥቃቱ አንድ ጥንዶች እና የሁለት ዓመት ህጻን ልጃቸው መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ አሜሪካ ለዚህ ተግባሯ ዋጋ እንደምትከፍል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ክስተቱ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Maatii warra magaalaa Qeshm irratti weerara humna waraana Ameerikaatiin ajjeefaman du’aatiin isaanii sirnaan raawwatameera. Weerara kanaan abbaa manaa, haadha manaa fi ijoollee isaanii waggaa lamaa du’uu isaanii hordofee, itti gaafatamaan mootummaa Iraan Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii fudhatteef gatii akka kaffaltu akeekkachiisaniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran hammaachiseera.

title: Death toll rises to 87 in India’s flood-stricken Assam
english: Severe monsoon flooding in India's Assam region has resulted in 87 deaths. Many residents have been displaced, forced to live in temporary shelters while their homes and agricultural lands remain underwater. Villagers are currently relying on makeshift rafts to salvage their personal belongings from the flooded areas.
amharic: በህንድ የአሳም ክልል በደረሰው ከባድ የዝናብ ጎርፍ የሟቾች ቁጥር 87 ደርሷል። ብዙ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸው እና እርሻቸው በውሃ በመጥለቅለቁ ምክንያት ተፈናቅለው በጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ለመኖር ተገደዋል። የገጠር ነዋሪዎችም ንብረቶቻቸውን ለማዳን በራሳቸው የተሰሩ ታንኳዎችን እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Godina Assaam kan biyya Indiyaa keessatti roobni cimaan waan roobeef lolaan mudate lubbuu namoota 87 galaafateera. Namoonni baay'een manneen isaanii fi lafti qonnaa bishaanin guutamee waan jiruuf, iddoo bultii yeroo keessa jiraachuuf dirqamaniiru. Jiraattoonni naannichaa qabeenya isaanii bishaan keessaa baafachuuf meeshaa bishaan irra deeman gargaaramuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Six years on, Beirut blast families still await justice
english: Families of those killed in the 2020 Beirut port explosion gathered to mark the six-year anniversary of the tragedy. They continue to call for government accountability and the completion of the long-delayed legal investigation. Many relatives expressed frustration and ongoing pain, as they still have not received the truth or justice they deserve.
amharic: የቤይሩት ወደብ ፍንዳታ ሰለባዎች ቤተሰቦች የአደጋውን ስድስተኛ ዓመት በሀዘን አስታውሰዋል። ተጎጂዎቹ መንግስት ለደረሰው ጥፋት ተጠያቂ እንዲያደርግ እና ለረጅም ጊዜ የዘገየውን የፍትህ ሂደት እንዲያፋጥን ጠይቀዋል። ፍትህ አለማግኘታቸው የቤተሰቦቹን ሀዘን እና ብስጭት እንደሚያባብስ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Maatiin namoota dhukaatee buufata doonii Bayirut waggaa ja’a dura mudateen lubbuunsaanii darbe, yeroo yaadatamaa jiru kana gaaffii haqaa dhiyeessaa jiru. Hawaasni kun qaamolee itti gaafatamummaa qaban seeratti akka dhihaatanifi qorannoon seeraa yeroodhaan akka xumuramu gaafataniiru. Haqni hanga yoonaatti argachuu dhabuunsaanii gaddaafi aarii maatiiwwan kanaa itti fufee akka jiru hubatameera.

title: National Guard deployment to Washington, DC will cost US roughly $1.4bn
english: The U.S. Defense Department estimates that keeping National Guard troops in Washington, D.C. through January 2029 will cost approximately $1.4 billion. About 2,500 soldiers are expected to remain stationed in the capital to carry out tasks like patrolling and assisting with city operations. This decision has faced significant pushback from local leaders and some lawmakers, who view the ongoing presence as an expensive and unnecessary militarization of the city.

title: US says deal on reopening Hormuz close as Iran, Oman hold ‘positive’ talks
english: The United States and Iran are nearing an agreement to secure safer shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz, with Oman acting as a mediator for the talks. While both sides have characterized the discussions as positive, some technical and security disagreements regarding the waterway's operation remain. Officials from both countries suggest that a deal could be finalized very soon, which would help lower regional tensions.

title: US Centcom says Hormuz remains 'free and open'
english: The US Central Command has confirmed that the Strait of Hormuz continues to be accessible for international commercial shipping. Despite recent aggressive actions by Iran, American forces have safely guided over 1,000 ships through the waterway in the last three months. The U.S. maintains that this vital route stays open for all merchant vessels traveling through the area.
